title: Warmly Braised Greek Turnip Stew
description: A tangy and snappy Greek stew featuring turnips, perfect for a solo dinner, braised to perfection in a hot pot vessel, and FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the cubed turnips, garlic free seasoning, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the lemon juice and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the vessel, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Check the turnips for tenderness, and continue to simmer if necessary.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
